sloka: मयस्तथाब्रवीद्राम पृच्छन्तं तं निशाचरम् ।श्रूयतां सर्वमाख्यास्ये यथावृत्तमिदं मम ।। ७.१२.५ ॥
transliteration: mayastathābravīdrāma pṛcchantaṁ taṁ niśācaram ।śrūyatāṁ sarvamākhyāsye yathāvṛttamidaṁ mama ।। 7.12.5 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, Maya thus spoke to the inquiring night-wanderer, "Listen, I shall narrate all that has happened concerning me."
